parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query.

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The keyword that is used for the query.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of records that can be returned for the query.

Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 30.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that marks the position from which you want to start the query. If you leave this parameter empty, the query starts from the beginning.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name.

> For more information, see [Alibaba Cloud services that support Quota Center](~~182368~~).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun quotas list-alarm-histories --next-token 1 --max-results 30 --keyword Quantity --start-time 20201020 --end-time 20201024 --product-code ecs --alarm-id 18b3be23-b7b0-4d45-91bc-d0c331aa0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun quotas ListAlarmHistories --region cn-hangzhou --AlarmId '18b3be23-b7b0-4d45-91bc-d0c331aa0000' --NextToken 1 --Keyword Quantity --EndTime 20201024 --ProductCode ecs --MaxResults 30 --StartTime 20201020
